newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-SA PINTO MUST SERVE BAN BEFORE SPAIN MOVE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SA PINTO MUST SERVE BAN BEFORE SPAIN MOVE.

text.p: Sporting Lisbon's Ricardo Sa Pinto must complete a 12-month ban for assaulting national coach Artur Jorge before his agreed $4 million move to Spain's Real Sociedad can proceed, FIFA has decided.
In a letter to Real Sociedad, FIFA said Sa Pinto "could not be registered until the suspension has come to an end".
Luis Uranga, president of the Spanish first division, said that he expected Sa Pinto to appeal against the suspension imposed last week by the Portuguese federation.
"We think that the player and his lawyers will file an appeal," said Uranga, who said he would respect the ban even though he found it "excessive".
Sa Pinto struck Jorge at the national team's training ground in March after being left out of the squad for a World Cup qualifier against Northern Ireland.
